title: Which Lines Outside Cover Are Restated on the Claim Record, by the Way They Reached the Supplement
content:
Of the crossover lines falling outside cover on a policy under Medicare Supplement Insurance Policies, which are restated on the claim record turns on how those lines reached the supplement.

| How the lines outside cover reached the supplement | The liability restated here |
|---|---|
| They reached the supplement as an automatic crossover from Medicare | The liability of those automatically crossed-over lines |
| They were submitted by the policyholder herself | Nothing is restated here, the money having gone to her and being asked of her instead |
| Neither of those describes them | The liability of every line outside cover |

### Notes on the table

The rows are taken in the order set out. Where any line outside cover reached the supplement as an automatic crossover from Medicare, that row governs and the liability of those crossed-over lines is what is restated here, the money on them having gone to the provider.

The second row is reached only where no line outside cover came across automatically. Where the lines outside cover were submitted by the policyholder herself, nothing is restated here.

The last row governs where the lines outside cover fall into neither description, and takes the liability of every line outside cover.

### Hypothetical records

A claim record whose lines outside cover include two that came across automatically from Medicare and one the policyholder submitted: the first row governs, and the liability of the two automatically crossed-over lines is what is restated here.

A claim record whose only lines outside cover were submitted by the policyholder herself: nothing is restated here.
